description: Clone a voice from an audio sample (clean speech, ideally 10 s – 3 min, one speaker) and get a voice id for text_to_speech. minimax ($1.41; use the id with minimax-speech-* models), elevenlabs (free, up to 10 voices, each kept 24 hours), fish (first 20 voices free, then $1 each; use the id with fish-* models). Only clone a voice with the speaker's consent.

description.description: fish only: a short description of the voice.

name.description: Display name. Required for elevenlabs and fish.

sample.description: The audio sample: public https:// URL, LOCAL FILE PATH, localhost URL or data: URI (local files up to 10 MB are uploaded for you). mp3, wav or m4a; Fish also takes opus.

voice_id.description: minimax only: your own id for the voice, 8–256 characters, starting with a letter (letters, digits, - and _). Generated if omitted.

name: clone_voice
